propositions: A new `rebar metrics` CLI subcommand must parse `--since`, `--until`, and `--output json|text` arguments and render the full metric registry over the specified date range.

The metrics command must wire through explicit dispatch in `_cli/__init__.py` (an `if sub == 'metrics'` arm on the reads path) and import the full `rebar.metrics` package to hydrate the REGISTRY before rendering.

The command must evaluate every MetricSpec in the registry using a context object carrying repo_root, since, and until, wrapping each evaluate call in try/except to render unavailable metrics on failure rather than crashing.

JSON output (default) must emit `{"since", "until", "metrics": {id: {lens, source, confidence, value} | {unavailable: {reason, accruing_since}}}}` and text output must list one metric per line with id, lens, source, and value or unavailable reason.

The command source must not import `rebar.metrics.adapters` (portability guard), and the CLI dispatch, help text, golden snapshots, and help-overview-coverage test must all account for the new subcommand.
